dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Mondstadt has changed so much in the short time I've been gone...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Oh — I don't mean that I don't like the way things are now. I guess I just get a little nostalgic for the days I spent with the Grand Master's expedition sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I wonder where they're all up to now? And whether they need any new maps...
